author: Ryan Daws
description:
Amazon Threat Intelligence has tied a DPRK hacking group to four separate NPM package supply chain attacks, including axios. The company’s security teams have connected the axios, debug, chalk, and typo-crypto package incidents to a single actor tracked across the industry under five names: SAPPHIRE SLEET, STARDUST CHOLLIMA, BlueNoroff, CageyChameleon, and Alluring Pisces.
